name: Cats in Heat - Convenience Coworkers
source:
Step into the shoes of a manager of a small convenience store in some franchise. Experience hardships and unexpected situations with your coworkers!

Did I mention it's mating season and girls need to relieve their tension?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2520190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演某連鎖品牌旗下一家小便利商店的店長，與同事們一起，經歷困難與意外狀況！

我說過了嗎？現在是交配季，女孩們需要紓解壓力。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2520190/]Steam[/url]]
